verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document scoped or least-privilege API keys that could be issued to an agent. The docs describe "One key, one endpoint," and the roles and permissions material covers only Dashboard users, which is an adjacent control. Per-agent virtual cards with spend rules scope payment instruments, not API credentials, so they do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
